loanReference: Nigeria Human Capital Development Program Phase II — IDA Credit No. IDA-7041
stageRationale: Stage 1 — No significant increase in credit risk. Nigeria remains an IDA/IBRD blend eligible country; project disbursements on schedule. Oil revenue volatility monitored.

loanReference: Zambia AgriConnect Digital Agriculture Platform — IDA Credit No. IDA-7298 (DDP Flagship)

loanReference: DRC Eastern Congo Stabilisation & Recovery Programme — IDA Credit No. IDA-6892
stageRationale: Stage 2 — Significant credit risk increase due to ongoing armed conflict in eastern DRC (M23 activity, ADF operations). IDA Fragile & Conflict-Affected Situations (FCS) protocol applied. Interest payments 90+ days overdue Q3 2024.

loanReference: Ethiopia Productive Safety Net Program Phase 5 (PSNP5) — IDA Credit No. IDA-6988
stageRationale: Stage 1 — Post-Tigray Peace Agreement (Nov 2022) transition to recovery. IMF ECF program signed 2023. Debt-to-GDP at 55% elevated but manageable. Service charge payments current.

loanReference: Pakistan Energy Sector Transformation Programme — IDA Credit No. IDA-7412
stageRationale: Stage 2 — Elevated risk from circular debt (~PKR 2.4T), energy sector reform delays, and political instability. IMF SBA stabilisation underway. IPP contract renegotiations impacting disbursement pace. Enhanced monitoring per OP 10.00.
